I Daring, intrepid;
(1) साहसिकः (की,
 कं);
(2) साहसिन् (f. नी)
II Impudent,
rude: q. v.:
III Of expression etc. प्रगल्भः
(ल्भा, ल्भं),
a b. speaker
प्रगल्भवाच् (mfn.), D.
Ph.
it is a mere b. assertion that there is no
part of the Vedas treating of existing things.
भूतवस्तुपरो वेदभागो नास्तीति वचनं साहसमात्रम्, S. i.
4.
IV Conspicuous, prominent: q. v. V.
Steep: q. v. To make b. (to say): निर्भयं or
प्रगल्भं
or
साहसेन (वदति).

BOLDLY:
I Courageously:
(1) साहसेन;
(2)
निर्भयम्
II Impudently: q. v.

BOLDNESS:
I Courage:
(1) साहसं,
pleased with
the b. of the weaver
कौलिकसाहसानुरञ्जितमनसा, P. i. 5; []
(2) निर्भीकता (=intrepidity);
(3) शौर्यम् (=
valour).
II Of language: साहसम्।
III Im-
-pudence: q. v. साहसं,
it is b. to be in front
of a master
पत्युः पुरः साहसमासितव्यम्, Ki.
BOLSTER UP (v.): v. To support, prop up.

BOLT (subs.):
I A missile, a dart: q. v.
II
For securing doors:
(1) अर्गलम्;
(2) विष्कम्भः
(rare).
III Thunder-bolt: q. v.

BOLT (v. t.):
I To secure with a bolt:
(1)
अर्गलेन पिदधाति (धा, c. 3.)
or
रुणद्धि (रुध्, c. 7.)
or
बध्नाति (बन्ध्, c. 9);
(2) अर्गलं ददाति (दा c.
3.) (with gen.).
II To fasten, restrain:
q. v.
III To sift: q. v.
IV To examine:
q. v. V. To exhibit: q. v.

BOLT (v. i.): निष्पतति (पत् c. l.), M. viii. 55.:
v. To depart. Also=to start abruptly:
q. v.
